# Paul Rubell, Attorney At Law, P.C.

> A boutique law firm that practices at the intersection of business and technology. Based in Melville, New York (Long Island), serving established and emerging companies, entrepreneurs and investors.

## Who

Paul Rubell, Esq. is a business and technology attorney and the principal of Paul Rubell, Attorney At Law, P.C. He provides legal counsel, business advice and strategic planning to established and emerging companies, entrepreneurs and investors.

Paul is a national leader in the fields of technology and privacy law. He advises clients about domestic and international privacy laws involving healthcare, financial services, education and other verticals, as well as disruptive technologies and innovation such as blockchain, augmented reality, cybersecurity, encryption, 3D printing, robotics and space exploration.

His writings have been published frequently in the New York Law Journal and other periodicals. He has been interviewed about legal topics by CBS-TV, ABC-TV, National Public Radio, The New York Times, Associated Press, Long Island Business News, Newsday, Law360, and the national media. He lectures frequently to boards of directors, trade associations and not-for-profits. He is rated by Super Lawyers.

## Practice areas

- **Business law** (/Litigation): general corporate counsel, conventional financing, venture capital financing, M&A transactions, business formation, shareholder disputes and litigation strategy.
- **Corporate law** (/corporate): forming business entities including corporations, partnerships and joint ventures; representing foreign and domestic companies in cross-border movement of goods, services and capital. Clients range from multinational companies to small businesses.
- **Real estate law** (/real-estate): land acquisition and disposition, ownership and transactions, financing, land use planning, and management of real estate assets.
- **Technology and privacy law**: domestic and international privacy regimes, cybersecurity, encryption, blockchain, AR, 3D printing, robotics, space exploration.
- Also: mergers and acquisitions, private equity, venture capital, private and public securities offerings, governance, partnership agreements.

## Representative transactions

- Naboso — $3,000,000 venture capital investment from Protea Japan (represented Naboso).
- Indaba Renewable Fuels — $750,000 pre-development capital investment (represented the lead investor).
- Cyberus Labs — $2,000,000 seed capital infusion (represented the lead investor).
- Blue Orb — $1,000,000 capital investment (represented the lead investor).
- International Art Trading, LLC — $25,000,000 line of credit (represented the borrower).
